title: Just-In-Time Agent Memory with Runtime Agentic Research
title_zh: 基于运行时智能体研究的即时智能体记忆
abstract_en: Memory is critical for AI agents. Many existing agent-memory systems follow an Ahead-of-Time (AOT) design, constructing memory before a specific request arrives. While this reduces online serving cost, such request-agnostic memory construction can discard fine-grained information that later becomes important. To address this limitation, we propose Just-In-Time Agent Memory (JAM), a trainable framework for query-conditioned context construction at runtime. A Memorizer preserves complete raw histories in a hierarchical page-store with compact navigational summaries, while a Researcher iteratively retrieves, inspects, and integrates evidence for each request. To train these memory-use behaviors, we introduce Memory-Gym, an evidence-grounded data synthesis pipeline covering nine task types across six domains, and optimize the Researcher through verified-trajectory supervised fine-tuning followed by Hint-guided Group Relative Policy Optimization. We demonstrate the effectiveness of JAM across a variety of benchmarks on agent memory and long-context processing, where it achieves stronger task performance than AOT-style memory systems while remaining substantially more efficient than prior trained agentic memory approaches. To support reproducibility and future research, we release our anonymized source code at https://github.com/VectorSpaceLab/general-agentic-memory.
abstract_zh: 记忆对 AI Agent 至关重要。现有许多智能体记忆系统采用 Ahead-of-Time（AOT，预先构建）范式，即在具体请求到达前建立记忆。该设计虽能降低在线服务成本，但与请求无关的记忆构建可能丢弃后续任务所需的细粒度信息。为解决这一问题，本文提出 Just-In-Time Agent Memory（JAM），一个在运行时根据查询动态构建上下文的可训练框架。JAM 中的 Memorizer 使用带有紧凑导航摘要的分层页面存储，保留完整原始历史；Researcher 则针对每个请求迭代地检索、检查并整合证据。为训练上述记忆使用行为，作者进一步提出 Memory-Gym，这是一套基于证据的数据合成流程，涵盖六个领域中的九类任务。Researcher 首先通过经过验证的轨迹进行监督微调，随后采用 Hint-guided Group Relative Policy Optimization 优化。实验表明，在多项智能体记忆与长上下文处理基准上，JAM 的任务性能优于 AOT 式记忆系统，同时相比以往经过训练的智能体式记忆方法具有更高效率。作者还公开了匿名源代码，以支持结果复现与后续研究。
key_points_zh: 提出 Just-In-Time Agent Memory（JAM），将静态的 AOT 记忆构建改为查询条件化的运行时上下文构建。
Memorizer 通过分层页面存储保留完整原始历史，并利用紧凑导航摘要支持高效定位，减少细粒度信息丢失。
Researcher 针对当前请求迭代执行证据检索、检查与整合，以智能体式研究过程生成任务相关上下文。
提出 Memory-Gym 数据合成流程，覆盖六个领域、九类任务，并结合 verified-trajectory supervised fine-tuning 与 Hint-guided Group Relative Policy Optimization 训练 Researcher。
在智能体记忆和长上下文基准上，JAM 优于 AOT 式记忆系统，且比既有可训练智能体记忆方法更高效。

llm_assessment.comment: A strong and reusable Agent-memory framework that combines raw-history preservation, query-conditioned runtime research, trainable memory use, and a broad synthesis benchmark.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项强且可复用的 Agent Memory 工作，结合了原始历史保留、查询条件化运行时研究、可训练记忆使用和广泛的数据合成基准。
